Team — quick alignment for this week's numbers submission. Please read and action before our 11:00 standup. Short, concrete asks below.

   - Confirm close probability updates for all Top-20 by ARR.

2) Commit line: add final commit amounts in column "COMMIT_Q3" on the attached spreadsheet. If you're unsure, put a conservative number and flag in the notes column.

3) Red flags to surface on the call: procurement delays, legal gating, pricing approvals.

Standup (Zoom): 2029-06-03 11:00 PT — agenda (15m):
   - 0-3m: Quick snapshot (Marissa)
   - 3-9m: Top 5 deals — blockers + ask owners (Grace)
   - 9-12m: Escalations needing leadership sign-off (Jordan)
   - 12-15m: Confirm submission readiness and follow-ups

Attachments: 2029W23-forecast-template.xlsx (fill COMMIT_Q3). Also paste any HubSpot links in the sheet.

Quick notes: I'll lock the submission at 15:00 PT if we don't have outstanding clarifications. If any account needs a manager-level exception or credit ask, flag it to me directly.

Thanks — J.
